title: Wise Words
subtitle: WITH MARCO REYES  ·  STORY NIGHT

segments.head: TONIGHT: THE LEAKY FAUCETS
segments.author: Wise Words
lines: Good evening, everyone.
I'm Marco Reyes, and this is Wise Words.
Tonight's story is about Hank, a plumber from Asheville, North Carolina.
Every Tuesday, Hank bowls on a team called the Leaky Faucets.
In three years, they had not won a single game.

segments.head: CHAPTER 1: THE NEW CAPTAIN
segments.quote: If you aren't fired with enthusiasm, you will be fired with enthusiasm.
segments.author: Vince Lombardi
lines: Then their captain moved to Florida, and everybody looked at Hank.
Hank said yes, mostly because he was eating nachos and didn't hear the question.
His first night, the team showed up late and staring at their phones.
Hank remembered his old boss's sign, from coach Vince Lombardi:
If you aren't fired with enthusiasm, you will be fired with enthusiasm.
So Hank brought a cowbell. Every strike, he rang it. Every gutter ball, louder.

segments.head: CHAPTER 2: THE STAR
segments.quote: Alone we can do so little; together we can do so much.
segments.author: Helen Keller
lines: Their best bowler was Darlene, an emergency room nurse with a perfect hook.
But she bowled like she was alone, and sighed at every miss.
By the shoe rental hung an old sign from Helen Keller:
Alone we can do so little; together we can do so much.
Hank asked Darlene for one favor. Teach Pete.

segments.head: CHAPTER 3: THE NATURAL
segments.quote: Genius is one percent inspiration and ninety-nine percent perspiration.
segments.author: Thomas A. Edison
lines: Pete was a quiet accountant whose ball always found the gutter.
Darlene's a natural, Pete said. I'm not.
Darlene laughed. I practiced for ten years. Then she quoted Thomas Edison:
Genius is one percent inspiration and ninety-nine percent perspiration.
So every Sunday morning, the team practiced. With lots of coffee.

segments.head: CHAPTER 4: THE WORST NIGHT
segments.quote: I can accept failure, everyone fails at something. But I can't accept not trying.
segments.author: Michael Jordan
lines: Then one night, Pete threw four gutter balls in a row.
He sat down. I quit. I'm only hurting the team.
Hank pointed at the Michael Jordan sticker on Pete's water bottle:
I can accept failure, everyone fails at something. But I can't accept not trying.
Pete stood up and knocked down seven pins. Hank rang that cowbell like crazy.

segments.head: CHAPTER 5: JUST LUCKY
segments.quote: Diligence is the mother of good luck.
segments.author: Benjamin Franklin
lines: Then the Leaky Faucets won a game. Then two. Then five.
The top team's captain rolled his eyes. You just got lucky.
Hank smiled. His grandpa's toolbox had a Ben Franklin saying on the lid:
Diligence is the mother of good luck.
So on the morning of the final, they practiced. Again.

segments.head: CHAPTER 6: THE LAST FRAME
segments.quote: You just can't beat the person who never gives up.
segments.author: Babe Ruth
lines: League final. Last frame. Pete needed nine pins to win.
His hands were shaking. Darlene said what Babe Ruth once wrote:
You just can't beat the person who never gives up.
Pete rolled. Nine pins fell. The last one wobbled, and fell too.
They won. And Hank's cowbell is now banned from the alley.

segments.head: THAT'S TONIGHT'S STORY
segments.quote: Bring the energy. Play together. Practice. Keep trying. Make your luck. Never give up.
segments.author: Marco Reyes
lines: That's tonight's story.
Bring the energy. Play as a team. Practice. Keep trying. Make your luck. Never give up.
I'm Marco Reyes. Good night. I bowled once myself. The pins were never in danger.
